title: Latest Record per Key (CDC Dedupe)
hints: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, event_id DESC) numbers each customer's events newest-first.
Keep rn = 1, then drop rows whose op is 'D'. Filtering 'D' before ranking would resurrect the previous version, which is wrong.
DuckDB supports QUALIFY so you can filter on the window function without a CTE.
